content.short: Para is a non-custodial embedded wallet SDK using MPC, with email, phone and social login.
content.description: Para lets applications create wallets for users behind familiar logins, splitting keys with MPC so the wallet stays non-custodial while the user never handles a seed phrase. Embedded wallets are how most consumer applications now onboard users, having concluded that seed phrase education is a losing battle at scale.
